title: Risk Perceptions of E-Cigarettes and the Evaluation of EVALI Messaging
title_zh: 电子烟风险认知与EVALI信息传播效果评估
title_primary: 电子烟风险认知与EVALI信息传播效果评估
title_secondary: Risk Perceptions of E-Cigarettes and the Evaluation of EVALI Messaging
authors: Lawrence Jin, Donald S. Kenkel, Alan D. Mathios, Grace N. Phillips, Revathy Suryanarayana 等
official: 官方在线 2026-09-07 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: With the growth of sales of e-cigarettes and other alternative nicotine products, governments face the new challenge of crafting public health messages that provide information to consumers about these less risky but not risk-free products. Bayesian learning serves as the theoretical framework for our analysis of how smokers form their perceptions of the risks of e-cigarettes based on the risks of smoking. This paper consists of two parts. First, we conduct a cross-country descriptive analysis of government messaging and smokers’ perceptions of e-cigarette risks. We study a diverse group of eight countries: Australia, China, Indonesia, Japan, Malaysia, Sweden, the U.K. and the U.S. We find that public health messages range widely across the countries. In online cross-country surveys of adult smokers, on average perceptions of e-cigarette risks are associated with their perceptions of the risk of smoking and with their countries’ messaging. Notably, in all eight countries many smokers incorrectly believe that e-cigarettes are relatively more harmful than smoking and over-estimate the absolute risks of e-cigarettes. In the second part of our study, we report the results of online randomized experiments that compare the effects of different e-cigarette risk messaging about an outbreak of lung injuries (given the acronym EVALI). The U.K. public health message about the low risk of e-cigarettes relative to smoking reduced smokers’ incorrect risk perceptions, while the U.S. public health message increased incorrect risk perceptions.

title: On deterministic optimal mechanisms in a two-item setting for distributions with nondecreasing density
title_zh: 确定性最优机制：两物品情形下非递减密度分布的研究
title_primary: 确定性最优机制：两物品情形下非递减密度分布的研究
title_secondary: On deterministic optimal mechanisms in a two-item setting for distributions with nondecreasing density
authors: D. Thirumulanathan
official: 官方在线 2026-09-03 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Consider the problem of designing a revenue-optimal auction mechanism when two heterogeneous items are sold to a single buyer having independent valuations over the items. The distributions of the buyer's valuation for the items are assumed to have densities that are positive, nondecreasing, and continuously differentiable on their support sets $[c_i,c_i+b_i]$ in the positive axis. I prove that the optimal mechanism is deterministic if at least one of the minimum valuations (i.e., either $c_1$ or $c_2$) is sufficiently high. I provide a method to calculate the threshold of $(c_1,c_2)$ beyond which the optimal mechanism is deterministic. I also provide a sufficient condition on the distributions of buyer's valuations for which the individual sale mechanism is optimal. I show that when $c_1$ is low and $c_2$ is high, it is optimal for the seller to sell item $2$ at the minimum valuation $c_2$, thus effectively reducing the problem to finding the optimal mechanism in the one-dimensional setting only for item $1$. I conjecture with promising preliminary results that this result can be extended to the three-item setting. Specifically, I conjecture that when $c_1$ and $c_2$ are low but $c_3$ is high, it is optimal for the seller to sell item $3$ at the minimum valuation $c_3$, thus effectively reducing the problem to finding the optimal mechanism in the two-dimensional setting for items $1$ and $2$.
abstract_zh: 考虑在将两种异质商品出售给对商品具有独立估值的单一买家时，设计收益最优拍卖机制的问题。假设买家对商品的估值分布具有正密度、非递减且在支撑集[ci, ci + bi]（位于正半轴）上连续可微。我证明，如果至少一个最低估值（即c1或c2）足够高，则最优机制是确定性的。我提供了一种方法来计算(c1, c2)的阈值，超过该阈值后最优机制即为确定性的。我还给出了买家估值分布的一个充分条件，在该条件下，单独销售机制是最优的。我表明，当c1较低而c2较高时，卖家以最低估值c2出售商品2是最优的，从而有效地将问题简化为仅针对商品1的一维设置中的最优机制求解。我推测，基于有前景的初步结果，这一结论可以扩展到三商品设置。具体而言，我推测当c1和c2较低但c3较高时，卖家以最低估值c3出售商品3是最优的，从而有效地将问题简化为针对商品1和2的二维设置中的最优机制求解。

title: News‐Driven Household Macroeconomic Expectations: Regional vs. National Telecast Information
title_zh: 新闻驱动的家庭宏观经济预期：区域与全国电视广播信息的比较
title_primary: 新闻驱动的家庭宏观经济预期：区域与全国电视广播信息的比较
title_secondary: News‐Driven Household Macroeconomic Expectations: Regional vs. National Telecast Information
authors: JUSTINE GUILLOCHON
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2026-08-31 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Using variations in the human‐annotated topic content of national and regional telecasts, I explore the link between aggregated daily news and household unemployment, inflation, and economic situation expectations in France. Beyond the information included in national statistics, household expectations embody news information on topics related to the state of the economy, such as deficit, living cost, and economic crisis. Inflation expectations additionally incorporate news on taxes, energy, and especially oil. Distinguishing regional from national television broadcasts reveals that household expectations incorporate both regional and national news, with news on local labor market conditions having a prominent role.
abstract_zh: 利用国家和地方电视转播中人工标注的主题内容差异，我探讨了法国汇总每日新闻与家庭对失业、通胀及经济状况预期之间的联系。除了国家统计数据所包含的信息外，家庭预期还融入了与经济状况相关的新闻主题信息，如赤字、生活成本和经济危机。通胀预期额外包含了关于税收、能源，尤其是石油的新闻。区分地方与国家电视广播显示，家庭预期同时吸纳了地方和国家新闻，其中关于本地劳动力市场状况的新闻扮演着突出角色。

title: Changing Gender Norms across Generations: Evidence from a Paternity Leave Reform
title_zh: 代际间性别规范的变迁：来自陪产假改革的证据
title_primary: 代际间性别规范的变迁：来自陪产假改革的证据
title_secondary: Changing Gender Norms across Generations: Evidence from a Paternity Leave Reform
authors: Christina Felfe
official: 官方在线 2026-08-21 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Social norms are an important barrier to gender convergence in economic outcomes. We study whether a public policy designed to promote gender equality at home can pave the way towards gender convergence by shaping gender norms in the next generation. We exploit the introduction of paid paternity leave in Spain in 2007, which granted fathers 13 days of non-transferable paid leave after childbirth. Eligibility depended sharply on the child’s date of birth. We combine this policy variation with original survey data collected from adolescents and implement a within-school difference-in-differences design comparing children born just before and after the reform cutoff within the same school cohort, using adjacent cohorts as controls. Children exposed to paternity leave eligibility display more egalitarian gender attitudes and beliefs in early adolescence. They are also more likely to engage in counter-stereotypical household chores, and hold less gender-stereotypical expectations regarding future work and family roles. The effects largely disappear in late adolescence.
abstract_zh: 社会规范是阻碍经济成果性别趋同的重要障碍。我们研究旨在促进家庭内部性别平等的公共政策，是否能够通过塑造下一代的性别规范，为性别趋同铺平道路。我们利用西班牙2007年引入的带薪陪产假政策，该政策赋予父亲在孩子出生后13天不可转让的带薪假期。资格严格取决于孩子的出生日期。我们将这一政策变化与从青少年中收集的原始调查数据相结合，实施校内双重差分设计，比较同一学校队列中在改革截止日期前后出生的儿童，并以相邻队列作为对照组。暴露于陪产假资格下的儿童在青春期早期表现出更平等的性别态度和信念。他们也更可能参与反刻板印象的家务劳动，并对未来的工作和家庭角色持有较少的性别刻板印象预期。这些影响在青春期后期基本消失。

title: Systemwide Stress Test at the IMF: Integrating Nonbank Financial Intermediary Risks
title_zh: 国际货币基金组织的系统性压力测试：整合非银行金融中介风险
title_primary: 国际货币基金组织的系统性压力测试：整合非银行金融中介风险
title_secondary: Systemwide Stress Test at the IMF: Integrating Nonbank Financial Intermediary Risks
authors: Ms. Hiroko Oura & Guillaume Arnould & Xiaodan Ding & Pierpaolo Grippa & Mr. Marco Gross & Mr. Dimitrios Laliotis & Mindaugas Leika & Caterina Lepore & Elisa Letizia & Ms. Laura Valderrama & Yuchen Zhang
official: 官方在线 2026-08-14 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper presents the IMF’s systemwide stress testing approaches, which cover multiple financial sub-sectors and their clients. Developing these tools is crucial for identifying cross-sector and cross border amplification channels and enhancing policy responses, as recognized by the international financial stability community. The paper reviews classic and modern theories and operational methods for analyzing systemic liquidity risks that impact numerous institutions simultaneously, illustrating how shocks can spread through banks, nonbank financial institutions (NBFIs), and market-based finance via runs, redemptions, margin and collateral calls, fire sales, price dynamics, and disruptions in core markets. It details two base IMF tools—an Excel-based flow-of-funds framework and investment fund liquidity analysis with fire sale and market-impact dynamics—and their application and enhancement within Financial Sector Assessment Programs (FSAPs) across various countries.
abstract_zh: 本文介绍了IMF的系统性压力测试方法，这些方法覆盖多个金融子行业及其客户。正如国际金融稳定界所认识到的，开发这些工具对于识别跨部门和跨境放大渠道以及加强政策应对至关重要。本文回顾了分析同时影响众多机构的系统性流动性风险的经典与现代理论及操作方法，阐述了冲击如何通过银行、非银行金融机构（NBFIs）以及基于市场的融资渠道，经由挤兑、赎回、保证金和抵押品追缴、抛售、价格动态以及核心市场中断而传播。文章详细介绍了IMF的两个基础工具——基于Excel的资金流量框架和包含抛售及市场影响动态的投资基金流动性分析——以及它们在各国金融部门评估规划（FSAPs）中的应用与增强。

title: Diagnosing ADHD in Prison: The Effects on Inmates and Their Families
title_zh: 监狱中诊断注意缺陷多动障碍：对囚犯及其家庭的影响
title_primary: 监狱中诊断注意缺陷多动障碍：对囚犯及其家庭的影响
title_secondary: Diagnosing ADHD in Prison: The Effects on Inmates and Their Families
authors: Randi Hjalmarsson, Matthew Lindquist
official: 官方在线 2026-01-21 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Attention Deficit and Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) is highly prevalent amongst criminal justice populations: ADHD diagnoses and medication are upwards of five times more likely for individuals who have a Swedish prison record than those without. We merge Swedish prison registers (with detailed healthcare data) to out-of-prison healthcare, crime, and employment data to study the effect of in-prison ADHD diagnoses. For individuals with no ADHD history, this new diagnosis treatment can include an information shock, medication and/or therapy. We compare the pre- and post-prison dynamics for treated inmates to alternative undiagnosed comparison groups: all untreated individuals, untreated early spells for repeat offenders treated in later spells, or a matched and reweighted control group. A robust set of findings emerge. New in-prison ADHD diagnoses significantly and persistently increase post-prison ADHD and substance abuse related healthcare. Crime and labor market outcomes, however, do not improve. There are also significant family spill-over effects: both children and siblings with no previous history of ADHD are more likely to be treated for ADHD after a newly diagnosed family member’s prison spell. Though prison appears to serve as an institution to bring high-risk, vulnerable populations into the public healthcare system, our results suggest that ADHD related care may not be as effective at lowering crime as many policy makers argue.
abstract_zh: 注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）在刑事司法人群中高度普遍：有瑞典监狱记录的个人被诊断患有ADHD及接受相关药物治疗的可能性，比无此记录者高出五倍以上。我们将瑞典监狱登记数据（包含详细的医疗保健信息）与狱外医疗保健、犯罪及就业数据相结合，以研究狱内ADHD诊断的影响。对于无ADHD病史的个体，这一新诊断治疗可能包含信息冲击、药物治疗和/或心理治疗。我们将接受治疗的囚犯在入狱前后的动态变化，与多种未接受诊断的对照组进行比较：所有未接受治疗的个体、在后续刑期中接受治疗的重复犯罪者早期未治疗刑期，以及经过匹配和重新加权的对照组。一系列稳健的研究发现随之浮现。狱内新诊断的ADHD显著且持续地增加了出狱后与ADHD及药物滥用相关的医疗保健使用。然而，犯罪和劳动力市场结果并未得到改善。此外，还存在显著的家庭溢出效应：在家庭成员新近被诊断并经历监狱刑期后，无ADHD病史的子女和兄弟姐妹接受ADHD治疗的可能性均有所增加。尽管监狱似乎充当了将高风险、弱势群体引入公共医疗体系的机构，但我们的结果表明，ADHD相关护理在降低犯罪方面的效果可能并不如许多政策制定者所主张的那样显著。

title: The New Keynesian Climate Model
title_zh: 新凯恩斯主义气候模型
title_primary: 新凯恩斯主义气候模型
title_secondary: The New Keynesian Climate Model
authors: Jean-Guillaume Sahuc, Frank Smets, Gauthier Vermandel, Tobias Adrian, Marcin Kolasa 等
official: 官方在线 2024-12-08 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We investigate their implications for monetary policy by developing and estimating a tractable nonlinear New Keynesian Climate model featuring climate damages and mitigation policies for the global economy. We find that mitigation policies aligned with the Paris Agreement result in higher, more persistent inflation than laissez-faire policies. Central banks can attenuate this inflationary pressure by accounting for the rising natural rate of interest, at the cost of lower GDP during the transition. This short-term trade-off ensures long-term macroeconomic stability resulting from a net-zero emission world.
abstract_zh: 我们通过构建并估计一个包含气候损害与全球减缓政策的可处理非线性新凯恩斯气候模型，探讨其对货币政策的影响。研究发现，与《巴黎协定》相一致的减缓政策会导致比放任政策更高且更持久的通胀。中央银行可通过考虑自然利率的上升来缓解这一通胀压力，但代价是转型期间GDP下降。这一短期权衡确保了净零排放世界带来的长期宏观经济稳定。

title: CEO aging and investment propensity: Experimental evidence
title_zh: CEO老龄化与投资倾向：实验证据
title_primary: CEO老龄化与投资倾向：实验证据
title_secondary: CEO aging and investment propensity: Experimental evidence
authors: Steffen Brenner, Jeppe Christoffersen, Torben Andersen, Thomas Plenborg
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-08-12 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Firms led by older CEOs invest less, but the mechanism behind this age–investment gradient remains unclear. We study how CEO age shapes investment evaluation by eliciting CEOs' ratings of a project's investment attractiveness in a large-scale scenario-based experiment with more than 3700 CEOs from owner-managed Danish firms. Our design provides direct evidence on CEOs' investment evaluations by separating baseline differences in investment attractiveness from sensitivity to risk moments and payout horizon. Each CEO evaluates randomized capital-budgeting scenarios relative to the status quo, allowing us to distinguish a baseline shift in willingness to view projects as compelling from age differences in responsiveness to risk characteristics and payout horizon. We document a pronounced negative association between CEO age and investment attractiveness. Holding expected IRR, variance, skewness, and payout horizon constant, CEOs aged 60 or older rate the same opportunities as less attractive, while age differences in sensitivity to these attributes are weak. Standard stated risk attitudes and a lottery measure show no systematic age pattern. For external validity, we construct a CEO-specific inaction propensity from the experiment—the residual tendency to rate otherwise identical projects as less attractive after accounting for project characteristics—and show that it predicts lower investment in administrative data. Including this measure attenuates the reduced-form age–investment association, suggesting that age-related investment declines are not readily explained by conventional risk preferences or investment horizons alone, but also reflect a broader residual tendency towards lower investment propensity.
abstract_zh: 由年长CEO领导的企业投资较少，但这一年龄-投资梯度背后的机制尚不明确。我们通过一项涉及超过3700位丹麦所有者管理企业CEO的大规模情景实验，研究CEO年龄如何影响投资评估，实验中让CEO对项目的投资吸引力进行评分。我们的设计通过将投资吸引力的基线差异与对风险矩和支付期限的敏感性分离开来，提供了关于CEO投资评估的直接证据。每位CEO相对于现状评估随机化的资本预算情景，使我们能够区分将项目视为有吸引力的意愿的基线变化与年龄在风险特征和支付期限响应性上的差异。我们记录了CEO年龄与投资吸引力之间显著的负相关关系。在保持预期内部收益率、方差、偏度和支付期限不变的情况下，60岁及以上的CEO将相同机会评为吸引力较低，而年龄对这些属性敏感性的差异则较弱。标准陈述的风险态度和彩票测量未显示出系统性年龄模式。为验证外部有效性，我们从实验中构建了一个CEO特定的不作为倾向——在考虑项目特征后，对原本相同的项目评为吸引力较低的残余倾向——并显示它能预测行政数据中较低的投资水平。纳入这一测量削弱了简化形式的年龄-投资关联，表明与年龄相关的投资下降不能仅由传统风险偏好或投资期限轻易解释，还反映了一种更广泛的低投资倾向的残余趋势。

title: The new hazardous jobs and worker reallocation
title_zh: 新危险职业与工人再配置
title_primary: 新危险职业与工人再配置
title_secondary: The new hazardous jobs and worker reallocation
authors: Gaetano Basso, Tito Boeri, Alessandro Caiumi, Marco Paccagnella, Mario Daniele Amore 等
official: 官方在线 2020-07-26 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: This paper analyses several dimensions of workers’ safety that are relevant in the context of a pandemic. We provide a classification of occupations according to the risk of contagion: by considering a wider range of job characteristics and a more nuanced assessment of infection risk, we expand on the previous literature that almost exclusively looked at feasibility of working from home. We apply our classification to the United States and to European countries and we find that roughly 50% of jobs in our sample can be considered safe, although a large cross-country variation exists, notably in the potential incidence of remote working. We find that the most economically vulnerable workers (low-educated, low-wage workers, immigrants, workers on temporary contracts, and part-timers) are over-represented in unsafe jobs, notably in non-essential activities. We assess the nature of the reallocation of workers from unsafe to safe jobs that is likely to take place in the years to come, and the policies that could mitigate the social cost of this reallocation.
abstract_zh: 本文分析了在疫情背景下与工人安全相关的几个维度。我们根据传染风险对职业进行了分类：通过考虑更广泛的工作特征和更细致的感染风险评估，我们扩展了先前几乎仅关注居家办公可行性的文献。我们将此分类应用于美国和欧洲国家，发现样本中约50%的工作可视为安全，尽管各国之间存在显著差异，尤其是在远程工作的潜在普及率方面。我们发现，经济上最脆弱的工人（低教育程度、低工资工人、移民、临时合同工及兼职者）在不安全工作中占比过高，尤其是在非必要活动中。我们评估了未来几年可能发生的工人从不安全工作向安全工作重新配置的性质，以及可能减轻这一重新配置社会成本的政策。

title: Authoritarian Propaganda and Social Networks
title_zh: 威权宣传与社会网络
title_primary: 威权宣传与社会网络
title_secondary: Authoritarian Propaganda and Social Networks
authors: Konstantin Sonin, Yixin Mei, Yanhui Wu, Alex Cukierman
official: 官方在线 2025-05-31 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Information manipulation is a powerful tool in the hands of any authoritarian leader. Dictators block independent media, censor news, pay influencers, and control citizens' social connections. In our model, citizens acquire information from censored sources or through social networks. Naturally, information manipulation has less impact when consuming news is costly and percolation in the network is low. Less intuitively, it might be optimal for the regime to target peripheral, rather than centrally connected citizens, and the propaganda's maximum impact is when percolation of information is close to zero (the society is atomized) or close to one, but not in-between.
abstract_zh: 信息操纵是任何威权领导者手中的强大工具。独裁者封锁独立媒体、审查新闻、收买舆论影响者，并控制公民的社会联系。在我们的模型中，公民通过受审查的渠道或社交网络获取信息。自然，当新闻消费成本高昂且信息在网络中的渗透率较低时，信息操纵的影响较小。而更反直觉的是，政权可能更倾向于针对边缘化而非核心社交联系的公民进行操纵，且宣传的最大影响力出现在信息渗透率接近零（社会原子化）或接近一时，而非介于两者之间。

title: Using AI to Let History Speak About Bank Runs
title_zh: 利用人工智能让历史讲述银行挤兑
title_primary: 利用人工智能让历史讲述银行挤兑
title_secondary: Using AI to Let History Speak About Bank Runs
authors: Sergio A. Correia, Stephan Luck, Emil Verner
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Banking crises are commonly associated with bank runs and banking panics, yet our empirical understanding of bank runs is constrained by a lack of bank-level data. In a new paper, we use large language models (LLMs) to extract information on bank runs from millions of digitized historical newspaper pages, creating the most comprehensive database of bank runs in U.S. history. Every bank run episode that we identify is documented on a companion website where users can browse and examine individual episodes, and read the original newspaper articles. In this post, we describe how we built this dataset and discuss what its basic features reveal.
abstract_zh: 银行危机通常与银行挤兑和银行业恐慌相关联，然而我们对银行挤兑的实证理解受限于缺乏银行层面的数据。在一篇新论文中，我们利用大型语言模型（LLMs）从数百万页数字化历史报纸中提取银行挤兑信息，构建了美国历史上最全面的银行挤兑数据库。我们识别的每一次银行挤兑事件均记录在配套网站上，用户可浏览和查阅单个事件，并阅读原始报纸文章。本文中，我们描述了如何构建该数据集，并探讨其基本特征所揭示的信息。

title: Random Forests for Benefit Transfer
title_zh: 随机森林在效益转移中的应用
title_primary: 随机森林在效益转移中的应用
title_secondary: Random Forests for Benefit Transfer
authors: Robert J. Johnston, Klaus Moeltner
source: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
official: 聚合元数据日期 2026-04-15 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Benefit transfer (BT) has evolved as the dominant valuation method for environmental benefit-cost analyses, including those required of US federal agencies. Yet even best-practice approaches for BT based on meta-regression models (MRMs) typically exhibit poor predictive fit and out-of-sample precision. This article introduces random forests (RFs) for nonparametric estimation of MRMs and construction of BT predictions. We compare the performance of different RF models to current best-practice approaches for BT. We find that forest-based models substantially improve the out-of-sample accuracy of welfare predictions and tighten confidence intervals of predicted benefits for stipulated policy scenarios. The best performers reside within the family of local linear forests (LLFs), a hybrid approach that combines elements of RFs and locally weighted regression. Results suggest that this new approach has the potential to substantially improve BT accuracy for environmental policymaking without sacrificing theoretical properties, while simultaneously reducing econometric and computational difficulties relative to leading alternatives.
abstract_zh: 效益转移（BT）已成为环境效益-成本分析中的主导估值方法，包括美国联邦机构所需的分析。然而，即便是基于元回归模型（MRMs）的最佳实践BT方法，通常也表现出较差的预测拟合度和样本外精度。本文引入随机森林（RFs）用于MRMs的非参数估计及BT预测的构建。我们将不同RF模型的性能与当前BT最佳实践方法进行比较。研究发现，基于森林的模型显著提高了福利预测的样本外准确性，并收紧了规定政策情景下预测效益的置信区间。表现最佳的模型属于局部线性森林（LLFs）家族，这是一种结合了RFs和局部加权回归元素的混合方法。结果表明，这一新方法有潜力在不牺牲理论性质的前提下，显著提升环境政策制定中BT的准确性，同时相对于领先的替代方法，减少了计量经济学和计算上的困难。

title: Ideology-driven social media opinions and capital markets: Evidence from polarizing boycotts
title_zh: 意识形态驱动的社交媒体舆论与资本市场：来自两极分化抵制运动的证据
title_primary: 意识形态驱动的社交媒体舆论与资本市场：来自两极分化抵制运动的证据
title_secondary: Ideology-driven social media opinions and capital markets: Evidence from polarizing boycotts
authors: Xue Li
official: 官方在线 2026-06-20 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Investors increasingly turn to social media for information, even though many sites are saturated with ideological opinions. This paper examines whether ideology-driven social media opinions affect stock market responses to polarizing firm news, using boycotts as the empirical setting. On average, polarizing boycotts are associated with a 1% (2.3%) drop in equity value over the seven (60) trading days after gaining social media traction. Consistent with ideology-driven opinions affecting market responses, the immediate price reaction is more negative when users ideologically aligned with boycotters dominate social media, particularly when their opinions are visible and financially relevant. A mediation analysis suggests that this association operates indirectly through overall social media sentiment toward the boycotted firms. Additionally, trading volume and daily return volatility following boycotts are positively associated with user ideological diversity. Together, these results suggest that ideology-driven social media opinions could influence how investors respond to polarizing firm news.
abstract_zh: 投资者日益转向社交媒体获取信息，尽管许多平台充斥着意识形态观点。本文以抵制活动为实证背景，考察意识形态驱动的社交媒体观点是否影响股市对极化企业新闻的反应。平均而言，在获得社交媒体关注后的七（六十）个交易日内，极化抵制事件与股权价值下降1%（2.3%）相关。与意识形态驱动的观点影响市场反应相一致的是，当与抵制者意识形态一致的用户主导社交媒体时，即时价格反应更为负面，尤其是在这些观点可见且具有财务相关性的情况下。中介分析表明，这种关联通过社交媒体对受抵制企业的整体情绪间接发挥作用。此外，抵制事件后的交易量和日回报波动性与用户意识形态多样性呈正相关。综合来看，这些结果表明，意识形态驱动的社交媒体观点可能影响投资者对极化企业新闻的响应方式。

title: Robustly Optimal Voting Rule
title_zh: 稳健最优投票规则
title_primary: 稳健最优投票规则
title_secondary: Robustly Optimal Voting Rule
authors: Noriaki Kiguchi, Shinpei Noguchi, Yuta Takahashi
official: 官方在线 2026-06-16 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We examine optimal strategy-proof voting mechanisms in environments where the designer lacks precise information about the probability distribution of individual utility profiles. This uncertainty over the true distribution is represented by a set of multiple distributions, and the designer evaluates mechanisms using either the worst-case utility sum or worst-case regret. Departing from the existing literature, we do not assume that utility functions are single-peaked or that the set of possible utility functions is maximally rich. In this setting, we show that the median voter rule is the unique optimal mechanism under both criteria. Our result provides a new justification for this well-known mechanism from a welfare perspective.
abstract_zh: 我们考察在设计师对个体效用分布概率缺乏精确信息的环境中的最优策略性投票机制。这种对真实分布的不确定性通过一组多重分布来表示，设计师依据最坏情况下的效用总和或最坏情况下的遗憾来评估机制。与现有文献不同，我们不假设效用函数是单峰的，也不假设可能的效用函数集合是最大丰富的。在此设定下，我们证明中位选民规则是这两种标准下的唯一最优机制。我们的结果为这一知名机制从福利角度提供了新的合理性依据。

title: Noncooperative oligopoly in markets with a continuum of traders and a strongly connected set of commodities: A limit theorem
title_zh: 连续交易者市场与强连通商品集上的非合作寡头垄断：一个极限定理
title_primary: 连续交易者市场与强连通商品集上的非合作寡头垄断：一个极限定理
title_secondary: Noncooperative oligopoly in markets with a continuum of traders and a strongly connected set of commodities: A limit theorem
authors: Francesca Busetto, Giulio Codognato, Sayantan Ghosal, Ludovic Julien, Damiano Turchet
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We consider a mixed version of the Shapley window model, where large traders are represented as atoms and small traders are represented by an atomless part. Our main theorem shows that any sequence of Cournot-Nash allocations of the strategic market games associated with the partial replications of the exchange economy has a limit point for each trader and that the assignment determined by these limit points is a Walrasian allocation of the original economy. Instead of relying on restrictive assumptions on the characteristics of atoms, as in Busetto et al. (2017), our limit theorem relies on the characteristics of agents in the atomless part and their endogenously price-taking behavior.
abstract_zh: 我们考虑Shapley窗口模型的一个混合版本，其中大型交易者以原子形式表示，小型交易者则由无原子部分代表。我们的主要定理表明，与交换经济部分复制相关的战略市场博弈中，任何库尔诺-纳什配置序列对每位交易者都存在极限点，且由这些极限点确定的分配是原始经济的瓦尔拉斯配置。与Busetto等人（2017）依赖对原子特征的限制性假设不同，我们的极限定理依赖于无原子部分中代理人的特征及其内生价格接受行为。

title: Technology Transfer and Early Industrial Development: Evidence from the Sino-Soviet Alliance
title_zh: 技术转移与早期工业发展：来自中苏联盟的证据
title_primary: 技术转移与早期工业发展：来自中苏联盟的证据
title_secondary: Technology Transfer and Early Industrial Development: Evidence from the Sino-Soviet Alliance
authors: Michela Giorcelli, Bo Li
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper studies the long-term effects of technology and know-how transfers on structural transformations. In the 1950s, the Soviet Union supported the construction of the 156 Projects, which were large-scale, capital-intensive industrial clusters in China. These projects included a technology transfer, consisting of state-of-the-art Soviet machinery and equipment, and a know-how transfer, via the training of Chinese engineers, production supervisors, and high-skilled technicians by Soviet experts. We use newly assembled data that follow steel plants for over four decades, and we exploit natural variation in the transfers they eventually received. We find that, while production advantages stemming from Soviet technology faded away if not complemented with training, the know-how transfer had a long-lasting impact on plant performance, stimulated technology upgrade when China was a closed economy, and increased exports to the Western world when China engaged in international trade. The know-how transfer also generated productivity and technology spillovers onto complementary establishments.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了技术与知识转移对结构转型的长期影响。20世纪50年代，苏联援建了156项工程，这些工程是中国境内大规模、资本密集型的工业集群。这些项目包含技术转移（通过提供苏联最先进的机械设备）和知识转移（通过苏联专家培训中国工程师、生产主管及高级技工）。我们利用新汇编的跨越四十余年的钢铁厂数据，并借助这些工厂最终获得转移项目的自然差异进行分析。研究发现：若缺乏配套培训，源自苏联技术的生产优势会逐渐消退；而知识转移对工厂绩效具有持久影响，在中国封闭经济时期推动了技术升级，并在中国融入国际贸易后增加了对西方世界的出口。此外，知识转移还对配套企业产生了生产率与技术溢出效应。

title: On the Optimality of Full Disclosure
title_zh: 论完全披露的最优性
title_primary: 论完全披露的最优性
title_secondary: On the Optimality of Full Disclosure
authors: Emiliano Catonini, Sergey Stepanov
official: 官方在线 2026-05-12 · 来源：RSS
abstract: A privately informed sender can commit to any disclosure policy toward a receiver, whose actions affect the utility of the sender. We show that full disclosure is optimal under a sufficient condition with some desirable properties. First, it speaks directly to the parties' utility functions, as opposed to the sender's indirect utility function; this makes it easily interpretable and verifiable. Second, it does not require the sender's payoff to be a function of the posterior mean state. Third, it is weaker than the conditions obtained in the literature for some specific settings.
abstract_zh: 拥有私人信息的发送者可以向接收者承诺任何信息披露政策，而接收者的行为会影响发送者的效用。我们证明，在具备某些理想性质的充分条件下，完全披露是最优的。首先，该条件直接针对双方的效用函数，而非发送者的间接效用函数，因此易于解释和验证。其次，它不要求发送者的收益是后验均值状态的函数。第三，它比文献中针对某些特定情境所得出的条件更为宽松。

title_zh: 动态互补性
title_primary: 动态互补性

authors: Heckman, James, Tian, Haihan, Zhang, Zijian, Zhou, Jin, Heckman, James J.
official: 官方在线 2026-05-04 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Dynamic complementarity is the concept that past investments that lead to higher stocks of skill at an age, promote the growth of skills from investment at that age. We define and produce evidence on dynamic complementarity and its three components using unique Chinese data from a home visiting program for young children targeted to parents in rural China. In addition, we investigate growth in learning due to innate, parental, and environmental factors that occur in the absence of any formal intervention.
abstract_zh: 动态互补性是指过去投资在某个年龄段形成更高技能存量，从而促进该年龄段投资带来的技能增长这一概念。我们利用中国农村地区针对幼儿家长的家访项目独特数据，对动态互补性及其三个组成部分进行了界定并提供了实证证据。此外，我们还研究了在没有任何正式干预的情况下，由先天因素、父母因素和环境因素导致的学习增长。

title: How does the Kids SIPsmartER program impact the sugar‐sweetened beverage intake of students: An investigation beyond total treatment effect in randomized controlled trial
title_zh: Kids SIPsmartER项目如何影响学生的含糖饮料摄入：随机对照试验中总处理效应之外的探究
title_primary: Kids SIPsmartER项目如何影响学生的含糖饮料摄入：随机对照试验中总处理效应之外的探究
title_secondary: How does the Kids SIPsmartER program impact the sugar‐sweetened beverage intake of students: An investigation beyond total treatment effect in randomized controlled trial
authors: Naveen Abedin, Wen You, Annie Reid, Kathleen Porter, Brittany Kirkpatrick 等
official: 官方在线 2026-03-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: ER (KSS) program, a 6-month, school-based intervention evaluated through a clustered randomized control trial in rural Appalachia to reduce sugar-sweetened beverage (SSB) consumption among 7th-grade students. KSS includes a classroom-based student component (KSS-S) grounded in the Theory of Planned Behavior and health literacy, and a caregiver component (KSS-C) delivered through two-way text messaging to modify household beverage practices. Using structural equation modeling grounded in a Stackelberg household production framework, we estimate how behavioral strategies, health literacy, and caregiver-child decision-making jointly shape students' SSB intake. Stronger behavioral intentions are associated with a 5.30 oz/day reduction (p<0.01), and the caregiver decision index (capturing household rules, availability, and role modeling) corresponds to a 16.41 oz/day reduction. KSS-S reduces intake by 6.42 oz/day (p<0.05), largely through a direct pathway (6.23 oz/day, p<0.05). KSS-C reduces intake by 4.22 oz/day, primarily through caregiver-mediated effects (3.36 oz/day). Combined, both components reduced students' SSB consumption by 10.64 oz/day (36% from baseline) (p<0.01). We use the estimated structural parameters to simulate hypothetical SSB tax scenarios, finding that KSS achieves reductions comparable to those generated by modest tax rates. This suggests that school-based behavioral interventions like KSS can function as complementary or alternative policy tools. By identifying causal mechanisms and enabling counterfactual policy simulations within a unified framework, the structural approach provides richer policy insights than average treatment effects alone.
abstract_zh: ER（KSS）项目是一项为期6个月的校本干预，通过集群随机对照试验在阿巴拉契亚农村地区评估，旨在减少七年级学生的含糖饮料（SSB）消费。KSS包括基于计划行为理论和健康素养的课堂学生组成部分（KSS-S），以及通过双向短信传递以改变家庭饮料实践的家庭照护者组成部分（KSS-C）。基于Stackelberg家庭生产框架，运用结构方程模型，我们估计了行为策略、健康素养及照护者-儿童决策如何共同影响学生的SSB摄入量。更强的行为意图与每日减少5.30盎司相关（p<0.01），而照护者决策指数（涵盖家庭规则、可得性和榜样作用）对应每日减少16.41盎司。KSS-S使摄入量每日减少6.42盎司（p<0.05），主要通过直接路径实现（每日减少6.23盎司，p<0.05）。KSS-C使摄入量每日减少4.22盎司，主要通过照护者中介效应（每日减少3.36盎司）。两者结合，将学生的SSB消费每日减少10.64盎司（较基线下降36%）（p<0.01）。我们利用估计的结构参数模拟假设的SSB税收情景，发现KSS实现的减少效果与适度税率产生的效果相当。这表明像KSS这样的校本行为干预可以作为互补或替代的政策工具。通过在统一框架内识别因果机制并进行反事实政策模拟，结构方法比仅依赖平均处理效应提供了更丰富的政策洞见。

title: The Impact of the Dodd–Frank Act on Small U.S. Banks
title_zh: 《多德-弗兰克法案对美国小银行的影响》
title_primary: 《多德-弗兰克法案对美国小银行的影响》
title_secondary: The Impact of the Dodd–Frank Act on Small U.S. Banks
authors: KUAN LIU
source: Journal of Money, Credit and Banking
official: 官方在线 2025-11-09 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Abstract I estimate a dynamic banking model to quantify the impact of the Dodd–Frank Act on small banks and bank entry in the United States. The model features a bank portfolio‐choice problem with a risk‐return trade‐off in the loan market. My counterfactual experiments uncover a novel regulatory dis‐synergy: while tighter capital requirements mitigate bank risk, higher compliance costs create a risk‐seeking incentive for banks. The interaction of the two creates a strong destabilizing effect that aggravates bank failures in the short run. Furthermore, I find that increases in regulatory burdens explain about 70% of the collapse of bank entry since 2010.
abstract_zh: 摘要 我通过估算一个动态银行模型，量化《多德-弗兰克法案》对美国小银行及银行进入的影响。该模型包含银行在贷款市场中的投资组合选择问题，涉及风险与收益的权衡。我的反事实实验揭示了一种新颖的监管负协同效应：虽然更严格的资本要求降低了银行风险，但更高的合规成本却为银行创造了追求风险的激励。这两者的相互作用产生了强烈的破坏稳定效应，在短期内加剧了银行倒闭。此外，我发现监管负担的增加解释了自2010年以来银行进入崩溃的约70%。

title: The long shadow of history? the impact of colonial labor institutions on economic development in Peru
title_zh: 历史的漫长阴影？殖民时期劳动制度对秘鲁经济发展的影响
title_primary: 历史的漫长阴影？殖民时期劳动制度对秘鲁经济发展的影响
title_secondary: The long shadow of history? the impact of colonial labor institutions on economic development in Peru
authors: Leticia Abad, Noel Maurer
official: 官方在线 2025-01-16 · 来源：RSS
abstract: We examine a canonical case of forced labor: the mita and the encomienda in colonial Peru. The mita was a labor draft designed to provide workers for mines, churches, and public works in colonial Peru and Bolivia. The encomienda granted a select group of Spanish settlers the right to extract labor and tribute from indigenous peoples. We examine the impact of forced labor using a dataset of 500 indigenous settlements scattered across modern-day Peru. We find that forced labor gravely impacted the Peruvian communities subjected to it, but the effects nearly dissipated before the end of the colonial period (1532-1811). We test for a possible “reversal of fortune” in the postcolonial period by looking at an array of variables for the 19th to the 21st centuries (literacy, access to land, road density, and luminosity) and find no significant differences. The results hold when we examine the mita and encomienda separately. The mechanisms that caused its impact to fade were migration, growing outside options for indigenous labor, and opposition from the Crown and new Spanish settlers who lacked access to forced labor.
abstract_zh: 我们考察了强迫劳动的一个典型案例：秘鲁殖民时期的米塔制与监护征赋制。米塔制是一种旨在为秘鲁和玻利维亚殖民地的矿山、教堂及公共工程提供劳动力的劳役征调制度。监护征赋制则赋予特定西班牙殖民者群体向原住民榨取劳役和贡赋的权利。我们利用涵盖现代秘鲁境内500个原住民定居点的数据集，分析了强迫劳动的影响。研究发现，强迫劳动对遭受其害的秘鲁社群造成了严重冲击，但这种影响在殖民时期（1532-1811年）结束前已近乎消散。通过考察19至21世纪的一系列变量（识字率、土地获取权、道路密度及夜间灯光亮度），我们检验了后殖民时期是否存在可能的“命运逆转”，结果未发现显著差异。当分别考察米塔制和监护征赋制时，结论依然成立。导致其影响消退的机制包括：人口迁移、原住民劳动力外部选择机会的增加，以及西班牙王室与无法获取强迫劳动的新移民殖民者的反对。
